questions.stem: Why must a plant be destarched before testing whether light is needed for photosynthesis?

options.text: To make the leaves softer for testing
To remove existing starch so any starch found must be newly produced
To kill any bacteria on the leaves
To increase the rate of photosynthesis during the experiment

questions.explanation: Destarching removes any starch already stored in the leaves, so a positive starch test after the experiment confirms that new starch was produced by photosynthesis.
